parts.text:

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: A proton may decay into a neutron together with two other particles.
parts.text:
Complete the following to give an equation that represents this proton decay.

$$^{1}_{1}\mathrm{p} \longrightarrow {}^{\boxed{\phantom{0}}}_{\boxed{\phantom{0}}}\mathrm{n} + {}^{\boxed{\phantom{0}}}_{\boxed{\phantom{0}}}\boxed{\phantom{\mathrm{x}}} + {}^{\boxed{\phantom{0}}}_{\boxed{\phantom{0}}}\boxed{\phantom{\mathrm{x}}}$$

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for this decay in terms of quark composition.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State the name of the force responsible for this decay.
